"GAME CONCEPT: RAT COUTURE
A Disturbing Fashion Competition

Create a fully playable, visually distinctive fashion competition game called RAT COUTURE.

1. CORE CONCEPT

RAT COUTURE is a surreal, grotesque, darkly humorous fashion competition featuring anthropomorphic rat people.

The player competes against four AI-controlled rat characters in an absurd fashion show.

The atmosphere should combine:

Underground fashion culture
Avant-garde fashion
Trash aesthetics
Body horror aesthetics (stylized, not realistic)
Surrealism
Dark humor
Glamour mixed with absolute ugliness
Disturbing but funny characters

The game should feel like an underground fashion reality show from an alternative universe.

It should be weird, provocative, grotesque, artistic and unpredictable.

2. CHARACTER CREATION

At the beginning, the player creates their own rat person.

Allow the player to choose:

Male or female body type
Fur color and texture
Face shape
Eye size and color
Nose shape
Ear shape
Teeth
Body proportions
Tail shape
Hairstyle
Facial hair
Skin details
Scars and deformities

Characters should look like bizarre anthropomorphic rats, not ordinary humans wearing rat masks.

The character creator should offer many combinations.

All visual choices should be saved and remain visible throughout the game.

3. THE FIVE COMPETITORS

Each competition consists of five characters:

The player
AI competitor 1
AI competitor 2
AI competitor 3
AI competitor 4

Each AI competitor should have:

A unique personality
A distinctive fashion style
Different visual characteristics
Different fashion preferences
Individual styling decisions

AI competitors must independently interpret the announced fashion theme.

They should not all wear similar outfits.

4. FASHION CATEGORIES

The game contains a large item database with the following categories:

Socks
Underwear
Bras
Piercings
Tattoos
Cigarettes
Makeup
Glasses
Hats
Insects (tiny companion creatures)

Each category should contain at least 10 different selectable items.

Examples:

SOCKS:

Dirty striped socks
Fishnet socks
Oversized wool socks
Transparent socks
One sock only
Neon socks
Hole-ridden socks
Victorian socks
Latex socks
Insect-patterned socks

HATS:

Broken crown
Moldy top hat
Plastic bag hat
Miniature bird nest
Rotten flower hat
Oversized fur hat
Industrial helmet
Crooked wizard hat
Tiny fascinator
Strange organic headpiece

INSECTS: Insects function as small fashion companions. Examples include:

Cockroach
Moth
Beetle
Spider
Praying mantis
Centipede
Fly
Scorpion
Caterpillar
Locust

Each insect should have its own visual appearance and position on the character.

Create at least 10 unique items for every category, with the possibility to expand the database later.

5. ROUND SYSTEM

Every round follows this structure:

STEP 1: THE JURY ANNOUNCES A THEME.

Themes are randomly selected from a large database.

Themes can be:

Completely absurd
Disturbing
Provocative
Glamorous
Mundane
Surreal
Darkly humorous

Example themes:

Divorced Cockroach at a Funeral
The Last Night at the Abandoned Strip Club
Rich Widow at the End of the World
Insect Fetish Couture
Supermarket After Midnight
The Smell of Forbidden Luxury
Failed Plastic Surgery Prom
Holy Trash
Corporate Rat From Hell
First Date in a Sewer
Victorian Poverty Glamour
Unemployed Demon
Birthday Party at the Morgue
Normal Tuesday

STEP 2: RANDOM CATEGORY SELECTION.

The game randomly selects FIVE different fashion categories from the category database.

Each selected category displays exactly 10 different items.

The player must select exactly ONE item from each category.

The remaining categories are unavailable during that round.

STEP 3: CHARACTER STYLING.

Display the character in a large interactive 3D or 2D preview.

Every selected item should immediately appear on the character.

Allow the player to rotate the character and inspect the outfit.

The player can change selections until confirming the final look.

STEP 4: AI COMPETITORS.

All four AI competitors independently create outfits based on:

The announced theme
Their personalities
Their individual fashion preferences
The available categories

STEP 5: THE RUNWAY SHOW.

All five competitors walk individually down a fashion runway.

Show:

Character entrance
Walking animation
Outfit presentation
Close-up shots of important accessories
Insect companion animations
Dramatic lighting
Audience reactions

The runway should feel like a bizarre high-fashion event.

6. THE JURY AND SCORING

Create three eccentric jury members.

Each jury member should have:

A unique appearance
A distinctive personality
Different fashion preferences
Individual comments and reactions

The jury evaluates each competitor based on:

Creativity
Interpretation of the theme
Visual coherence
Originality
Absurdity
Fashion impact

Each jury member gives an individual score from 1 to 10.

They should also generate funny, sarcastic, bizarre and occasionally brutally honest comments.

Example comments:

\"I hate everything about this. It's absolutely magnificent.\"
\"This looks like a tax fraud committed by a moth.\"
\"I see no fashion. I see a cry for help.\"
\"Disgusting. Revolutionary.\"
\"You understood the assignment in the worst possible way.\"

Calculate a combined score and create a ranking of all five contestants.

7. GAME PROGRESSION

The game should consist of multiple rounds.

After each round:

Display the results
Show the jury's comments
Reveal the ranking
Award points
Keep a cumulative leaderboard

The player should compete across several rounds to become the ultimate RAT COUTURE champion.

Add a final winner ceremony with a ridiculous fashion trophy.

8. VISUAL DESIGN

Art direction is extremely important.

Use:

Dirty neon colors
Acid green
Toxic pink
Deep red
Metallic silver
Dirty beige
Black
Industrial textures
Sewer-inspired environments
Underground club lighting
Distorted fashion magazine aesthetics

The interface should look like a mixture of an underground fashion magazine, a grotesque reality TV show and an avant-garde runway.

Avoid generic mobile game aesthetics.

The characters and clothing should be visually expressive, detailed and memorable.

9. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Build the game as a modular project.

Requirements:

Fully playable game loop
Character creation system
Modular clothing and accessory system
Random category selection
Item database
AI competitor logic
Theme generation system
Jury scoring system
Runway presentation
Round progression
Save and load functionality

Keep the code organized and suitable for GitHub.

Use reusable components and separate game logic from visual assets.

Make it possible to add new clothing items, themes, characters and animations without rewriting the core game.

10. IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENT INSTRUCTIONS

Do not create just a static mockup or a collection of screens.

Build a functional prototype with a complete playable game loop.

Start with:

Main menu
Character creator
Five competitors
Random theme generator
Random selection of five categories
Ten items per category
Outfit preview
Runway presentation
Jury scoring
Results screen

Prioritize a working game over decorative features.

The final result should feel like a playable, bizarre fashion competition with a strong and recognizable identity.

The ultimate goal: Make the player feel like they are participating in the most disgusting, glamorous and absurd fashion show in the universe.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
